svg.title: L1 Engine - route map
svg.text: Where every wire physically runs. Bundle order is branch order, so each wire peels off the outside of the bundle and nothing crosses. Lengths come from routes.ft once measured (M-2).
Solid: live. Dashed: run and capped. Only wires that leave the post are drawn; sealing plugs and reserved cavities are on sheet A. Generated by rx7.py diagrams - do not edit.
